candidate_evidence.quote: will assess the effects of adding BPM31510 onto a conventional treatment framework of RT and concurrent TMZ chemotherapy for subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with newly diagnosed pathologically verified GB.

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive a weekly, 96-h infusion of BPM31510 for a duration of 8 weeks.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational intravenous coenzyme Q10 (ubidecarenone) formulation; record mentions known allergy to CoQ10
arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive prophylactic Vitamin K1 at a recommended dose of 10 mg subcutaneously prior to the beginning of each week of BPM31510 therapy.

arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

role_evidence.quote: Subjects will receive the standard TMZ treatment for up to 12 cycles post BPM31510 treatment.

arms: BPM31510, Vitamin K1, RT and TMZ

coder_notes: Single-arm Phase 2 adding BPM31510 to standard RT + TMZ in newly diagnosed GBM. Vitamin K1 is prophylactic (supportive) with no antitumour hypothesis. cns5_terminology is historical because the conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' with no IDH or WHO reference. Industry support coded yes because the lead sponsor is a company.
